wireContract: POST /video-outcomes/claim is browser-session-only with existing Origin and CSRF protection. One permanent claim winner returns display_permission true and a neutral terminal outcome with frozen song identity or null. All duplicates and later sessions lose. No expiry, reclaim, release or winning response replay. Lost acknowledgment or crash after claim may permanently lose the notice. Sealed nonretryable failures and policy blocks only; published, unsealed, retryable and acceptance_unknown attempts are excluded. No raw moderation signals or media.
